violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: multiple food items in the walk- in refrigerator were not temping correctly. Such as, whole milk(68F &70F); light cream(72F); egg patties (73F & 64F & 68F); sliced cheese (72F); Orginal cream cheese (69F); vegetable (garden) cream cheese (69F); strawberry cream cheese(65F); avocado spread (68F); coffee milk (73F); and chipotle aioli (69F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT A TEMPERATURE AT A MAXIMUM TEMP OF 41F OR BELOW. PIC DISCARDED ALL FOODS THAT WERE TEMPING IMPROPERLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The walk-in refrigerator was temping at 60F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS DISCUSSED BROKEN WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR WITH OWNER. OWNER TOLD EHS THEY HAD A TECHNICIAN ON SITE TO LOOK AT THE WALK-IN FREEZER. THE TECHNICIAN WILL LOOK AT THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND FIX IT. FACILITY IS NOT ABLE TO USE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR UNTIL THE WALK-IN IS BACK TO WORKING PROPERLY.

violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI. Arrived.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed milk frother located at the coffee station is not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI. Cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: mixing spoons stored in water cup on counter. Used for mixing milks.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI. Washed and sanitized and kept dry.
